`pkg/cli/whoami/whoami.go`|Added `PrintFlags *genericclioptions.PrintFlags` and `resourcePrinterFunc printers.ResourcePrinterFunc` to `WhoAmIOptions`. Initialize PrintFlags, register `-o/--output` flags, build and store a printer when output is specified, branch WhoAmI() to emit a `userv1.User` via the printer (fallbacks preserved), and enforce mutual-exclusivity among `--show-*` and disallow `--output` with any `--show-*`.| |**Unit tests**
`pkg/cli/whoami/whoami_test.go`|Added tests that configure PrintFlags with a default output, set `resourcePrinterFunc`, and assert `oc whoami` produces non-empty serialized `userv1.User` in JSON and YAML; added a test validating JSON output is produced even when SelfSubjectReview creation errors and users fallback is used.| |**E2E CLI tests**
`test/e2e/cli.go`|Added three e2e cases: `oc whoami -o json`, `oc whoami -o yaml` (assert `kind/apiVersion/name/groups`), and a validation test ensuring `-o {json,yaml}` cannot be combined with each `--show-token|--show-context|--show-server|--show-console`.| ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant User participant CLI as "oc whoami" participant WhoAmI as "WhoAmI handler" participant API as "Kube API (SSReview / Users)" participant Printer as "Resource Printer" User->>CLI: run `oc whoami -o json` CLI->>WhoAmI: invoke WhoAmIOptions.WhoAmI() WhoAmI->>API: request SelfSubjectReview API-->>WhoAmI: SelfSubjectReview (or error) alt SelfSubjectReview success WhoAmI->>Printer: set GVK User, call resourcePrinterFunc(User) Printer-->>CLI: formatted output (JSON/YAML) else SelfSubjectReview error WhoAmI->>API: fetch legacy User API-->>WhoAmI: User object WhoAmI->>Printer: call resourcePrinterFunc(User) Printer-->>CLI: formatted output (JSON/YAML) end CLI-->>User: stdout ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. | | Test Structure And Quality | ⚠️ Warning | 50% of assertions (8/16) lack meaningful failure messages, making test failure diagnosis difficult in CI/CD logs. | Add meaningful failure messages to all bare Gomega assertions using the second-argument pattern to improve diagnostics. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ⚠️ Warning | Three new e2e tests use userv1.User API from user.openshift.io/v1 which is unavailable on MicroShift, but lack valid protection mechanisms like [Skipped:MicroShift], [apigroup:user.openshift.io], or exutil.IsMicroShiftCluster() checks. | Add [apigroup:user.openshift.io] tag to test names or implement exutil.IsMicroShiftCluster() check with g.Skip() to properly protect tests for MicroShift compatibility. |

`103-117`: **Consider `WithTypeSetter(scheme.Scheme)` instead of hard-coding the GVK.** Setting `user.openshift.io/v1` manually on both paths works, but couples this command to a specific kind. Other commands in this repo register the scheme once via `PrintFlags` (see `pkg/cli/rollback/rollback.go:95-100`) and let the type setter populate TypeMeta automatically. This would also be more accurate on the SelfSubjectReview path, where the object is synthesized from k8s authentication info rather than fetched from `user.openshift.io`. Not a blocker — flagging as a cleaner alternative.
